dedupe_keys.name: climate onebuilding org repository of building simulation weather files tmyx and other typical years

description: A repository of climate data for building simulation run by the creators of the EnergyPlus weather (EPW) format, offering typical meteorological years from many organisations, arranged by the seven WMO regions with a KML map and a spreadsheet per region. Its own TMYx files are derived from hourly data in NOAA's Integrated Surface Database with the TMY and ISO 15927-4:2005 methods, now for more than 17,300 locations and more than 55,200 files; a site can have a TMYx for its full record and for 2011 to 2025, 2009 to 2023, 2007 to 2021 and 2004 to 2018, with ERA5 solar radiation (via Oikolab) in the newer sets. Each location zip holds EPW, ESP-r CLM, Daysim WEA, PVsyst, DDY design days with ASHRAE design conditions, statistics and, where available, hourly precipitation. Coverage: all 249 ISO countries, plus national sets such as CWEC for Canada, California climate zones, Norway, New Zealand and Australian future files. Access: free downloads. Licence: not stated; cite the site. Caveats: not all locations have recent data, and quality depends on the source station. Simulation uses: weather inputs for building energy, overheating and PV simulation. Related records: the ASHRAE climatic design conditions and EnergyPlus.
